scenes.text: Roman symbols include I equals 1, V equals 5, X equals 10, L equals 50 and C equals 100. Use IV, IX, XL and XC for subtraction forms.
Write 29 as a Roman numeral. The answer is XXIX. Roman numerals use I, V, X, L and C: 29 equals XXIX.
A clock label for a school fundraiser is XLVII. What number is it? Pause to choose and explain.
A clock label for a school fundraiser is XLVII. What number is it? The answer is 47. XLVII represents 47.
